description: This file defines the SettingsTab view component for an iOS application, handling various user-configurable settings including gateway connections, device features, and app preferences. It manages UI elements, user interactions, and internal state related to device settings and network configurations.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: A SwiftUI View component representing the settings interface of the app, including network, device, and feature configurations.

methods.name: gatewayList
methods.description: Displays a list of available gateways based on the mode (all or available only).

methods.name: featureToggle
methods.description: Creates a toggle UI element with an info button for device features like voice wake or camera.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates connection to a specific gateway discovery model, handling connection state and diagnostics.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect to the last known gateway.

methods.name: gatewayDebugText
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the current gateway and discovery status logs.

methods.name: lastKnownButtonLabel
methods.description: Creates the UI label for connecting to the last known gateway, showing progress if connecting.

methods.name: syncManualPortText
methods.description: Syncs the manual gateway port text input with internal port state.

methods.name: applySetupCodeAndConnect
methods.description: Processes the setup code entered by the user and attempts connection to the gateway.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes and applies a raw setup code, configuring device credentials and gateway info.

methods.name: applySetupURL
methods.description: Parses a URL and applies its host, port, and TLS settings to the gateway configuration.

methods.name: resolvedManualPort
methods.description: Determines the port to use for manual gateway connection based on current settings.

methods.name: preflightGateway
methods.description: Checks reachability and configuration validity for the specified gateway host and port.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs a TCP connectivity probe to a specified host and port.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Initiates a manual connection to a gateway with user-provided host and port.

methods.name: resetOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state, clears credentials, and disconnects existing gateway connections.

methods.name: gatewayDetailLines
methods.description: Creates detail lines about a discovered gateway, including LAN, tailnet, and port info.
